headline: White House Still Bars CNN, MS NOW and Politico Despite Court Blocking Trump’s Ban
context: A federal court ordered President Trump to reverse his ban on the three news outlets, but reporters were denied access on Thursday. Their lawyers asked the judge to intervene; he ordered the administration to respond by 12:30 p.m.

sources.name: The New York Times
